question: A loan is to be repaid in two equal annual installments. If the rate of interest is 10% per annum, which is calculated on compound annual basis and each installment is ₹3,872, then the loan amount (in ₹) is
solution:
Given:

Rate of interest = 10%

Installment amount = ₹3,872

Number of installments = 2

Formula used:

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

Where, P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year, N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the loan amount be P.

According to the question,

3872(1 + 10/100)¹ + 3872 = P(1 + 10/100)²

⇒ 8131.2 = P × 1.21

⇒ P = 8131.2/1.21

⇒ P = 6720

∴ The loan amount is **₹6720.**
